params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: question  Priority: P2
Summary: Stocklist Dealer is making tutorials in the look of the platform and asks where the platform's colours and typeface are written down. They looked in the business-rules page and in the app and did not find them.

## What is asked

Which colours and which typeface the platform uses, and where to look them up, so the tutorials can follow the same look.

## Where it stands

The answer exists, but it is not findable and not readable for someone who is not building screens:

- The living reference is `/huisstijl` in the app (behind the login, R P2-4.6). Nothing in the app links to it: not the menu, not the footer, not the Documentatie page.
- The page never names the typeface. It shows the text roles in Inter, but the word "Inter" appears only in `resources/css/type.css`.
- The colour swatches show the token name (`--brand-blue`) and, for the brand colours, no note and no value. A hex code, which is what a slide or a video tool asks for, is only in a comment in `resources/css/colour.css`.
- The business-rules catalogue describes the type ladder (R P1-1.28) but no colour values.

## Proposed

- On `/huisstijl`, a first card that answers this question: the typeface with its weights and where to get it, and the brand colours with their hex codes, read from the same stylesheets as the rest of the page.
- Every colour swatch on the page shows its hex code.
- A link to `/huisstijl` on the Documentatie page, so it can be found from the app.

Source: Portal mail:35.
params.title: Where the platform's colours and typeface are written down (for tutorials)
